purpose: Course teamwork handoff, not a new benchmark or paper result.

choices.01_editing: All 12 frozen histories and 24 queries; six named methods out of nine. G/U/WrongD omitted to simplify method comparison, not based on case success. All 60 previously selected dense diagnostic records retained; three histories were an old development diagnostic, not representative sampling.
choices.02_strategy: All eight histories from the four selected public categories and all 80 final outputs; all 40 same-source extension outputs. Extension was prompted by a first-round gap and is not independent validation.
choices.03_style: All six casual histories and 48 corresponding outputs from the old cue ablation; all four new confirmation histories and all 52 outputs. Formal histories and encoder analyses omitted to focus on one readable feature. Old/new batches use related public question streams; no population generalization.

caveat: This handoff subset was chosen after results were known for clarity. It cannot estimate overall migration harm. Different queries/methods are not independent source samples. Historical N means role replay (B), not actual online A.
